svg.title: Controls and Where They Are Enforced

g.text: Controls and Where They Are Enforced
Every control in the register and where it is enforced: the systems and data assets it governs directly, and the capabilities it governs through recorded processes. A row with a capability
but no system means the model does not say which system enforces that control.
